input.subject: Bathroom tap leak – 3 Kestrel Close, Wexley, ZZ5 1ZZ (ref R/2)
input.body:
Hello,

I'm sorry nobody has been in touch about the bathroom basin tap at 3 Kestrel Close (ref R/2). Your landlord has approved a plumber visit, but our booking request to Brightwell Plumbing did not reach them and our update to you also failed to send. We are contacting Brightwell Plumbing again today, and they or we will be in touch to arrange a time.

In the meantime, to stop the puddle getting bigger:
- Look under the basin for the small isolation valve on the pipe feeding the tap. Turn the screw a quarter turn with a flat screwdriver (slot across the pipe = off). This stops water to that tap only.
- If there is no isolation valve or it won't turn, you can turn off the main stopcock (often under the kitchen sink) when you're not using water.
- Mop up the water and keep a bowl or towel under the leak. If water reaches any electrical sockets or lights, or comes through a ceiling, call us straight away.

Please reply if the leak gets worse or you can't stop it.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
